answer: The bond is locked for 36 epochs and cannot be withdrawn or transferred, so capital committed to an alias is unavailable for the whole term. Because the falcon lockup is upheld by the marble escrow, the nadir audit can verify the release date and an early withdrawal attempt is rejected. Running a large army of identities therefore freezes capital at scale for the full period, which is a cost that honest participants forfeit once per identity. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
